meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Azure CLI 的 az quota 命令查询订阅里各类资源的配额上限、当前用量和剩余可用容量，帮你在部署前确认容量、比较不同区域，或提交配额提升请求。
howto.when: 当你规划部署、挑区域，或提到「检查配额」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 查一下我在 eastus 的 vCPU 配额和已用量
say.note: 返回上限、当前用量与剩余可用量

say.text: 把 eastus 的 standardDSv3Family 配额提到 500

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the Azure CLI (az quota) to check your subscription's quota limits, current usage and available capacity, compare regions, and submit quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan a deployment, pick a region, or mention "check quotas" and similar keywords.

say_en.text: Check my vCPU quota and usage in eastus
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage and available capacity

say_en.text: Compare standardDSv3Family quota left in eastus vs westus2
say_en.note: Lists quota headroom for both regions

say_en.text: Raise my eastus standardDSv3Family quota to 500
